messages:
Mina: Quick plan 16h weekend burst for webinar promos. Move $5k from generic search into retargeting and test a fresh creative (UGC-style short) + countdown CTA. Target CPL <= $42.
Arjun: Baseline retarget CPL? and audience window?
Mina: Baseline 7d CPL = $58. Audience = 30d site visitors + webinar waitlist. Frequency cap 3/day.
Kat: Landing page ready: /webinar-landing-lite with thin video. UTMs?
Faye: Use utm_source=google, utm_medium=paid, utm_campaign=webinar_may_burst_v1, utm_content=ugc_short. Will add creative_id param.
AdsBot: Apply changes (Google Ads):
```
PATCH /googleads/v1/campaigns/rdw-retarget
{ "daily_budget": 5000, "bidding_strategy": "target_cpa", "target_cpa": 42 }
```
Also set ad_schedule 09:00-21:00 PT Fri-Sun.
RouterBot: HubSpot mapping: webinar signups -> sdr_queue; demo requests -> enterprise_queue. Webhook: https://hooks.redwood.dev/leadrouter (retries 3x).
Arjun: Budget split core/lookalike? 75/25?
Mina: Yes 75/25. If CPL < $30 for 2h straight, auto-pull $1k from search. If CPL > $80 for 1h, rollback.
Kat: I'll rotate creatives every 8h, mobile gets muted autoplay. Add variant without video for slow mobile.
Faye: Dashboard: I added instant_cpl (spend/registrations_1h) and mobile/desktop. I'll create alert: instant_cpl > 70 for 45m -> notify #marketing.
Arjun: Who's launching at 7am PT Friday? I can push the ads and watch pacing first 3 hours.
Mina: @Arjun please do. @Kat monitor creative rotation. @Faye watch alerts. If Growth-Bot flags overspend, pause lookalike first.
Arjun: Will post a short status in this thread after 1h.
Mina: Thanks. Keep messages brief during burst. :rocket:
